A.criterion: requested bytes == bytes in the dispatched program, and an independent bit-extraction decode of those bytes returns the requested field values, for every instruction of every case
A.note: section 3z does not apply as a precondition: no offset here is signature-derived
A.pass: gate_a.n_bad == 0 over all cases; dispatched_bytes_verified true for all

B.criterion: every arm has a pre-registered control that MUST move the observable
B.pass: all controls fire; a failed control makes its arm carrier-undecidable

C.criterion: every case carries a predicted bucket chosen before the run; arm T additionally carries a boolean expect_codeword
C.pass: bucket_ok true for every gated case; codeword_prediction_ok true wherever expect_codeword is not null

D.criterion: zero fields tagged COPIED or CARRIER over every field of every instruction of every program, verified after REBUILDING every program from the frozen inputs and asserting sha256 against raw

E.criterion: two clean G17P runs in canonical and shuffled order with identical programs and buckets, on a MEASURED-quiet machine, with recoveryCount recorded pre/post and every hang classified driver-recoverable vs accumulating
E.note: recoveryCount delta is RECORDED and attributed, not required to be zero: this matrix deliberately dispatches faulting encodings
E.pass: 0 program-hash disagreements, 0 bucket disagreements, 0 foreign dispatch runners in the quiet samples
